In April this year, OpenAI launched the upgraded image generation technology ChatGPT Images 2. Five months later, the company released an enhanced version, ChatGPT Images 2.5.

ChatGPT Images 2 represents a significant leap forward compared with the company's earlier image generation tools.

It adds 2K resolution output, support for multiple aspect ratios, and the ability to use web research to obtain up-to-date information. Images 2 also enhances non-Latin language processing capabilities, and offers two intelligence tiers: Instant and Thinking.

The latest version, Images 2.5, boasts "sharper details, faster generation, more precise editing, and improved creation and sharing tools".

OpenAI stated: "Images 2.5 delivers more natural lighting effects and richer textures, performs better at preserving subjects from reference images, and can more reliably follow editing instructions across multiple rounds of conversation."

"We have also reduced image generation latency by up to 50% compared with Images 2.0, allowing you to generate images and refine your ideas faster."

In addition, the company detailed a new "Sketch" function that lets users draw directly within ChatGPT and use it as a reference for image generation. OpenAI also launched templates for popular image formats and a prompt sharing feature that lets others try out your image generation ideas.

Furthermore, OpenAI will release two versions of Images 2.5 for developers to build features into their applications. GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst will be available through OpenAI's API:

GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare brings the same quality, editing, and speed improvements to the API, and is the preferred choice for most applications, delivering higher-quality images than GPT‑Image‑2 with a 50% reduction in latency. It is suitable for a variety of purposes including creator and social content, product experiences, visual search, rapid image prototyping, and high-volume generation. GPT‑Image‑2.5 Sunburst is designed for high-end visual workflows that require more precise editing control, suitable for production-ready promotional material creation or refined product images in creative and editorial workflows.

OpenAI noted: "Images 2.5 is rolling out today on desktop, mobile, and web to ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users at all tiers." You can click here to learn more about this new image generation technology.

This release of ChatGPT Images 2.5 follows last week's launch of GPT-6 Astra.
